thread:
alicia: Postmortem follow-up: we scoped a few alert tuning tasks but didn't lock owners. Need owners, deadlines, rollback plan. Short answers pls.

tom: I can take the dedupe/fingerprint work. Quick plan: add `dedupe_key` to the alert router and a suppression window default of 600s. I'll open a tiny PR and a smoke job.

sara: I can pair with Tom on the smoke job and add an alert-rate dashboard panel.

devon: I'll handle threshold tuning and paging rules. Proposal: for noisy db_conn alerts, change threshold from 4->10 errors/min with 5m eval window; add a paging grace of 10m per fingerprint. Will draft runbook.

alicia: Please include how we'll measure success (baseline vs post-change). Also include a rollback toggle flag `alerting.tuning.v1.enabled = false` in config.

oncall-bot: tom created PR 121: https://git.company/infra/alerting/pulls/121 - "router: dedupe_key + suppression window" (open).

tom: PR snippet: ```yaml
- name: db-conn-errors
  severity: high
  dedupe_key: "service|error_code|host_group"
  suppression_seconds: 600
```

sara: Dashboard panels I'll add: total_alerts_1h, unique_alert_fingerprints_1h, pages_sent_24h. Tagging with `oncall/alert-tune/mar2026`.

devon: Runbook changes: add checklists for 0-24-72h observations and rollback step to flip flag and revert PR. I'll also schedule a 30-day review recurring event.

alicia: Deadlines: Tom merge by 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC; Devon thresholds + runbook by 2026-03-27 EOD; Sara dashboard + smoke by 2026-03-27 12:00 UTC. I'll put these into the remediation tracker and assign owners.

tom: Acknowledged. I'll also add unit tests for fingerprint parsing.

sara: Acknowledged. I'll post a before/after chart in this channel once the panels populate.

devon: Acknowledged. I'll include a small canary rollout (10% routes) and monitor pages_sent, alert_rate, and incident_count for regressions.

alicia: Action items recap (added to tracker): 1) Tom - dedupe PR, tests, smoke job, canary rollout - due 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC. 2) Devon - thresholds + paging changes, runbook, schedule recurring review - due 2026-03-27 EOD. 3) Sara - dashboards, charts, before/after post - due 2026-03-27 12:00 UTC. 4) Alicia - update postmortem follow-up doc and confirm tracker assignments - due 2026-03-25 EOD.
